description: Primaire watergang is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by WDODelta. Een langgerekte verlaging in het terrein van natuurlijke of kunstmatige oorsprong die permanent of periodiek stromend water bevat.ToelichtingOppervlaktewateren waarvan de lengte aanzienlijk groter is dan de breedte. Naast specifieke benamingen zijn er nog vele andere in gebruik: tocht, wetering, vaart, sloot, gracht, leiding, open leiding, gang, wijk, priel, geul enz. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher WDODelta. Its tags are WDODelta, maandelijks. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/KML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
